programme.title: The Defiant Ones
programme.desc: In Stanley Kramer's cinema classic, screen legends Sidney Poitier and Tony Curtis star as two convicts on the run from a Southern work gang who are bound together by an unbreakable iron chain and separated by an unbridled hatred for each other.

programme.title: Lilies Of The Field
programme.desc: Nominated for 5 Academy Awards® including Best Picture and winner of the Best Actor Oscar® for Sidney Poitier for his role as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns and the small Arizona desert town in which they reside.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram (Paul Newman) and Eddie (Sidney Poitier) are two expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris, where their music is celebrated. When they fall in love with two vacationing American girls, they must decide if they should move back to America with them.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Down a Dark Hall
programme.desc: Based on Lois Duncan's young adult thriller, story follows Kit Gordy, a new student at Blackwood Boarding School, who must unlock the mysteries of the school's tragic past.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: Mo' Money
programme.desc: You can never be too rich...or too funny. Comedian Damon Wayans brings his rogue's gallery of outrageous characters to this action-filled comedy about a con artist who tries to go straight, but keeps getting pulled in the wrong direction.

programme.title: Underclassman
programme.desc: A young detective goes undercover at an elite private school to destroy an international stolen car ring.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The true, inspiring story of Jim Ellis, a charismatic school teacher who changed lives forever when he founded an African-American swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: The film chronicles the true story of Paul Rusesabinga (Don Cheadle), a brave hotel manager who risked his life and those of his family to take in more than 1,000 refugees during the 1994 genocide of the Tutsus by Hutu militia.

programme.title: Peking Opera Blues [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: The movie is set in chaotic 1920's China, when warlords fought each other for power while Sun Yat-Sen's underground movement tried to establish a democratic republic.

programme.title: A Chinese Odyssey: Part 1 - Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the inhuman form of Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and forced to remain human.

programme.title: A Chinese Odyssey: Part 2 - Cinderella
programme.desc: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and-worst of all-the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: Top Secret!
programme.desc: Top Secret! pits American rock star Nick Rivers against the dreaded East German High Command. It's a race against time as Nick teams up with Hillary Flammond to find her father.

programme.title: Baby Boom
programme.desc: J.C. has inherited a baby girl. An adoption falls through and the child becomes very attached to J.C., who keeps the baby. The child's mischief leads to J.C. losing her job and her boyfriend, but lead her to invent an applesauce recipe for children.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: U Turn
programme.desc: A small-time gambler stranded in a desert mining town is drawn into a twisted game with deadly stakes. Stars Sean Penn, Jennifer Lopez, and Nick Nolte.

programme.title: Raging Bull
programme.desc: RAGING BULL is director Martin Scorsese's lacerating film biography of middleweight boxing champion Jake LaMotta, who was known during his brief reign as "the Bronx Bull."

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage and Michael Peña star as two New York City Port Authority policemen who were trapped in the rubble of September 11, 2001.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Discovered by businessman Tim Daland, Cole is teamed with legendary crew chief and car-builder Harry Hogge to race for the Winston Cup at the Daytona 500. A crash nearly ends Cole’s career and he must turn to a beautiful doctor to regain his nerve.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Two young aspiring outlaws (Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane) manage to join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang, led by the aging Bill Doolin (Burt Lancaster). The gang’s heyday may be far behind them, but there’s still plenty of adventure left!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Across the Universe
programme.desc: A love story about a British boy and an American girl set against the backdrop of the social upheaval of the 1960s.

programme.title: Stripes
programme.desc: Bill Murray has joined the Army, and the Army will never be the same! When John Winger (Murray) loses his job, his car, his apartment and his girlfriend, all in one day, he decides he only has one option: volunteer for Uncle Sam.

programme.title: 30 Minutes or Less
programme.desc: The tale of three slacker friends and the adventures that ensure after one of them inadvertently robs a bank armed only with a large salami.

programme.title: Amityville 3-D
programme.desc: A reporter moves into the ominous Long Island house to debunk it of the recent supernatural events but is instead besieged by the evil manifestations of a demon-from-hell lurking in the basement.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Diary of the Dead
programme.desc: While on location filming a horror movie, a group of college students finds themselves overrun by zombies, and ultimately end up capturing the epidemic on film.

programme.title: City Of The Living Dead
programme.desc: The Seven Gates Of Hell have been torn open, and in three days the dead shall rise and walk the earth. As a reporter and a psychic race to close the portals of the damned, they encounter a seething nightmare of unspeakable evil.

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: A doctor stimulates a sensory gland in the brain. This allows him to see into "The Beyond". When he sees the inhabitants of this realm they can see him too. They are eager to introduce him to their world and the doctor gets more than he bargained for

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: Rock star Prince makes a spectacular feature film debut in this highly autobiographical blockbuster that won both an Oscar and a Grammy award.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese, in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides
programme.desc: In the mid-1970s, in a Michigan community, live the Lisbon sisters, five teenagers who have bewitched a group of neighborhood boys.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Lady Bird
programme.desc: A high schooler (Saoirse Ronan) must navigate a loving but turbulent relationship with her mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of her senior year.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Awakenings
programme.desc: Robert De Niro and Robin Williams star in a story of the consequences of a maverick doctor's medical miracle. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose off-hand arrogance triggers a tragedy which ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Breakheart Pass
programme.desc: As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Chato, a half-Apache horseman, is on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer, who is determined to see him dead. Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed, thanks to the unforgiving, cruel desert.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D. and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earths closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: The 6th Day
programme.desc: In the very near future, cattle, fish, and even the family pet can be cloned. But cloning humans is illegal - that is, until family man Adam Gibson comes home from work one day to find a clone has replaced him.

programme.title: Sydney White
programme.desc: A modern retelling of Snow White set against students in their freshman year of college in the greek system.

programme.title: The Sweetest Thing
programme.desc: A girl finds she is forced to educate herself on the etiquette of wooing the opposite sex when she finally meets Mr. Right.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: A "How to..." columnist agrees to write a first-hand account about what it takes to drive a man out of your life... in exactly 10 days.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: When Christine's gynecologist (guest star JASON ALEXANDER) suggests that she may be experiencing perimenopause, Christine tries to take charge of her hormones.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Christine proposes marriage to Barb to save her best friend from being deported to the Bahamas. Meanwhile, Richard attempts to propose marriage to New Christine.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Richard asks Christine to return her wedding ring -- previously his mother's -- so he can use it to propose to New Christine.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: After Barb is profiled in a business journal, new clientele hits the gym and business really picks up.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: When Russell discovers Timmy has a sister, he aims to impress her. Meanwhile, Jeff and Audrey set their neighbor Liz up on a date.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: When Jeff and Audrey learn their surrogate is pregnant, both of their lives change. Meanwhile, Timmy takes on the responsibility of wedding planner for Adam and Jennifer.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: When an old photo of Jeff appears in an art gallery, he decides it's time to make some changes in his life. Meanwhile, Russell experiences a slump with women until he sees a familiar face.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Jeff and Audrey panic when they are told they might be having twins. Meanwhile, Russell throws a citizenship party for Timmy to impress a girl.

programme.title: The Conners
programme.desc: Jackie prepares for a series of physical tests in an effort to rejoin the police force; Darlene confronts the insecurities in her marriage with Ben; Dan's deposition stirs up feelings; final farewells are made in true Conner family fashion.

programme.title: A Vigilante
programme.desc: A vigilante helps victims escape their domestic abusers.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: A battle-hardened mercenary leads a team of soldiers on a daring mission to rescue hostages in remote Africa.

programme.title: The Marsh King's Daughter
programme.desc: A young mother must confront her long-buried past as the child of a kidnapper and the girl he held captive when her father breaks out of prison. Convinced he intends to take her daughters, she sets out to find and kill him herself.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Beneath a woman's striking beauty lies a secret that will unleash her indelible strength and skill to become one of the most feared assassins on the planet.

programme.title: The Birdcage
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Gene Hackman, Nathan Lane and Dianne Wiest lead the laughs in this wild Comedy that insists you don't have to be a woman to be a mother.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Max and the gang's worlds converge when the gang wants Max as badly as he wants them, especially after they target him for the death of their former leader.

programme.title: Get the Gringo
programme.desc: A career criminal nabbed by Mexican authorities is placed in a tough prison, where he learns to survive with the help of a young boy.

programme.title: Beyond The Lights
programme.desc: The pressures of fame have superstar singer Noni on the edge until she meets Kaz, a young cop who works to help her find the courage to develop her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Just Another Girl on the I.R.T
programme.desc: A hip, intelligent Brooklyn teenager dreams of escaping life in the projects to go to college and eventually become a doctor. Things go awry when she meets a cute dude with a Jeep, a brownstone, and a mom who spends a lot of time at her boyfriend's.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when a Klingon ship is nearly destroyed by an apparent attack from the Enterprise. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture - The Director's Edition
programme.desc: The U.S.S. Enterprise proudly soars again in this new, beautifully restored Director's Edition of the original Star Trek movie classic. This edition features enhanced visual effects and a new sound mix, supervised by legendary director Robert Wise.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: 23rd century: the Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirk’s defeat of Khan and the creation of the Genesis planet are empty victories. Spock is dead and McCoy is inexplicably being driven insane. Then a surprise visit from Sarek, Spock’s father, provides a startling revelation.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)

programme.title: American Fiction
programme.desc: Fed up with the establishment profiting from Black entertainment that relies on offensive tropes, a frustrated novelist decides to write an outlandish Black book of his own, one that propels him to the heart of the hypocrisy he disdains.

programme.title: Barbershop
programme.desc: Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram (Paul Newman) and Eddie (Sidney Poitier) are two expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris, where their music is celebrated. When they fall in love with two vacationing American girls, they must decide if they should move back to America with them.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night (1967)
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.

programme.title: Frank Capra's Pocketful Of Miracles
programme.desc: Impish, gin-swilling New York City peddler "Apple Annie" (Bette Davis) has a problem: her daughter (Ann-Margret) has never seen her and believes Annie is society matron. Newly engaged, her daughter is coming to visit with a society fiancé in tow.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia
programme.desc: When a family moves from the city to a centuries-old house in rural Georgia, they are terrorized by malicious spirits seeking revenge.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The true, inspiring story of Jim Ellis, a charismatic school teacher who changed lives forever when he founded an African-American swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: The film chronicles the true story of Paul Rusesabinga (Don Cheadle), a brave hotel manager who risked his life and those of his family to take in more than 1,000 refugees during the 1994 genocide of the Tutsus by Hutu militia.

programme.title: Southside with You
programme.desc: From executive producer John Legend comes the touching love story inspired by the romantic first date between President Barack Obama and the First Lady.

programme.title: A Chinese Odyssey: Part 2 - Cinderella
programme.desc: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

programme.title: The Bodyguard from Beijing [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A corrupt businessman commits a murder and the only witness is the girlfriend of another businessman with close connections to the Chinese government.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend [English-Language Version]
programme.desc: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

programme.title: Top Secret!
programme.desc: Top Secret! pits American rock star Nick Rivers against the dreaded East German High Command. It's a race against time as Nick teams up with Hillary Flammond to find her father.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: History was made...by these guys? Zed and Oh are cavemen who stumble into an epic journey of biblical proportions. One's a bumbling hunter, the other's a gentle gatherer; together, they become unlikely participants in history's most pivotal moments.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Across the Universe
programme.desc: A love story about a British boy and an American girl set against the backdrop of the social upheaval of the 1960s.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: U Turn
programme.desc: A small-time gambler stranded in a desert mining town is drawn into a twisted game with deadly stakes. Stars Sean Penn, Jennifer Lopez, and Nick Nolte.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Wild Things
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon, Matt Dillon and Neve Campbell star in a steamy story of murder, intrigue and sex. Rated: R

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage and Michael Peña star as two New York City Port Authority policemen who were trapped in the rubble of September 11, 2001.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Discovered by businessman Tim Daland, Cole is teamed with legendary crew chief and car-builder Harry Hogge to race for the Winston Cup at the Daytona 500. A crash nearly ends Cole’s career and he must turn to a beautiful doctor to regain his nerve.

programme.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
programme.desc: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Two young aspiring outlaws (Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane) manage to join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang, led by the aging Bill Doolin (Burt Lancaster). The gang’s heyday may be far behind them, but there’s still plenty of adventure left!

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: 30 Minutes or Less
programme.desc: The tale of three slacker friends and the adventures that ensure after one of them inadvertently robs a bank armed only with a large salami.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Lady Bird
programme.desc: A high schooler (Saoirse Ronan) must navigate a loving but turbulent relationship with her mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of her senior year.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: When the Clark Family moves from Chicago to Cradle Bay, Steve is cautioned by Gavin Strick about the separating factions at the local high school, where the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic perfect students, rule.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps
programme.desc: The Craft meets The Howling in this edgy, modern werewolf tale in which a teenage girl must choose between saving herself and joining her sister in an otherworldly existence.

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: A doctor stimulates a sensory gland in the brain. This allows him to see into "The Beyond". When he sees the inhabitants of this realm they can see him too. They are eager to introduce him to their world and the doctor gets more than he bargained for

programme.title: Hellraiser
programme.desc: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: THE BLOB has returned in this horrific tale about a vile, malignant life-form that crashes to earth in a cozy, rural American town called Arborville. Untroubled by conscience or intellect, the Blob does only one thing-and does it well. Rated: R

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese, in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Forrest Gump

programme.title: Walking with Beasts

programme.title: Room At The Top
programme.desc: An ambitious young accountant schemes to wed a wealthy factory owner's daughter, despite falling in love with a married older woman.

programme.title: The Misfits

programme.title: The Seven Year Itch
programme.desc: With his family away for their annual summer holiday, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) decides he has the opportunity to live a bachelor's life. The beautiful but ditsy blond (Marilyn Monroe) from the apartment above his catches his eye.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails and Trautman is captured by Russian troops. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

programme.title: Mother's Day (2012)
programme.desc: Rebecca DeMornay is terrifying in this brutal gorefest. When her sons break into a home and take the owners hostage, she teaches them what real torture is all about. Costars Shawn Ashmore.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: The Outside Story
programme.desc: When Charles locks himself out of his building, he's forced to go horizontal and confront the world he's been avoiding in search of a way back inside.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: American Fiction
programme.desc: Fed up with the establishment profiting from Black entertainment that relies on offensive tropes, a frustrated novelist decides to write an outlandish Black book of his own, one that propels him to the heart of the hypocrisy he disdains.

programme.title: Circle Of Iron
programme.desc: Aspiring-martial artist Cord lives in a desert-like world where nearly everyone he meets practices or has practiced a martial art. He seeks to find the place where the true inner spirit of the martial arts is being taught.

programme.title: Ring of Fire
programme.desc: Los Angeles Chinatown is disrupted by the cross-town rivalry between two kickboxing clubs as the competitive sport is catapulted from the ring of a gymnasium to a ring of fire.

programme.title: Bloodfist
programme.desc: Don Wilson plays retired kickboxer Jake Raye, who travels to Manila, where his brother is favored to win a kickboxing competition.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: Two figure skating rivals are banned from the sport after a brawl over the gold medal. Joining forces, they find a loophole in the rules that allows them to skate again... as a pair!

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Three men are disenchanted with life and try to recapture their college days.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun is content to be a bright but unfocused surf slacker until the day he discovers a novel by acclaimed author Martin Skinner. Inspired, he suddenly leaves Orange County to study creative writing at Stanford University.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: A mother falls for a younger man while her daughter falls in love for the first time. Mother Nature messes with their fates.

programme.title: Griffin & Phoenix
programme.desc: Griffin and Phoenix is a poignantly funny love story about two people who face a seemingly insurmountable obstacle that may stand between them and a last chance at love.

programme.title: Autumn In New York
programme.desc: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

programme.title: A Most Wanted Man
programme.desc: Phillip Seymour Hoffman stars in this action-thriller from spymaster John Le Carre. German and U.S. intelligence agencies race to uncover the identity of a mysterious man.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Apocalypto
programme.desc: As the Mayan kingdom faces its decline, a young man is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression.

programme.title: The Master (2012)
programme.desc: Haunted by his past, WW-II veteran and drifter Freddie Quell (Joaquin Phoenix) crosses paths with a mysterious movement led by The Master (Phillip Seymour Hoffman) and his wife (Amy Adams).

programme.title: Margot At The Wedding
programme.desc: On the eve of her estranged sister Pauline’s wedding to unemployed musician/artist/depressive Malcolm at the family seaside home, Margot shows up to rekindle the sisterly bond and offer her own brand of “support.”

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Bad Ass
programme.desc: A Vietnam veteran who becomes a local hero after saving a man from attackers on a city bus decides to take action when his best friend is murdered and the police show little interest in solving the crime.

programme.title: Bad Ass 2: Bad Asses
programme.desc: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with grumpy old agoraphobic Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to kick ass and clean up the streets of L.A.

programme.title: The Reading
programme.desc: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist’s bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and-worst of all-the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Leslie Nielsen stars as Police Squad's own granite-jawed, rockbrained cop Frank Drebin, who bumbles across a mind control scheme to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

programme.title: Top Secret!

programme.title: The Aviator

programme.title: Forrest Gump

programme.title: Bandits

programme.title: State of Grace

programme.title: No Escape

programme.title: Single White Female

programme.desc: Cuando Kakashi consigue eliminar el maleficio de Sasuke, Orochimaru entra de repente en escena, y manifiesta su deseo de obtener el poder del Sharingan del Clan Uchiha. Mientras tanto, en el tercer examen preliminar, Zaku lucha contra Shino.

programme.title: Naruto: Estruendo Kunoichi: Las Rivales Se Confrontan
programme.desc: En el siguiente combate de la prueba preliminar Kankuro se enfrenta al subordinado de Orochimaru, Misumi. Pronto Misumi captura a Kankuro mediante un cuerpo con articulaciones que se dislocan. Pero lo que captura es solo un títere controlado por Kankuro.

programme.title: Naruto: La Batalla Máxima: ¡Cha!
programme.desc: El cuarta partido enfrenta a Sakura e Ino, que son amigas de la infancia y compiten por Sasuke. Sakura, que admira a Ino desde que eran muy jóvenes, no duda en enfrentarla y los dos ninjas parecen estar al mismo nivel de habilidades y determinación.

programme.title: Naruto: La Kunoichi Asesina Y El Tembloroso Shikamaru
programme.desc: El quinto partido enfrenta a Tenten vs Temari. Tenten, usa una gran variedad de armas de su arsenal, pero el enorme abanico de Temari las rechaza. El sexto partido Shikamaru vs Kin. Kin parece llevar ventaja al principio, pero Shikamaru usa su Jutsu.

programme.title: Naruto: Akamaru Desatado, ¿Quién Es El Más Perrón Ahora?
programme.desc: En el 7º combate, Naruto se enfrenta a Kiba y su perro Akamaru. Kiba utiliza su Jutsu en 4 para atacar a Naruto, parece estar entre la espada y la pared y consigue darle la vuelta a la situación.

programme.title: Naruto: Ataque Sorpresa. El Arma Secreta De Naruto
programme.desc: Al consumir píldoras de alimento, Kiba y Akamaru aumentan sus niveles de chakra y comienzan su contrataque sobre Naruto. Naruto utiliza su Jutsu de Transformación para despistar a Kiba e intenta ganar el combate.

programme.title: Naruto: Batalla Byakugan. Hinata Se Hace Valiente
programme.desc: Hinata y Neji, se enfrentan en el octavo partido. La agresividad de Neji avasalla a la tímida Hinata, pero ella recupera las fuerzas al oír las palabras de Naruto. Dado que ambos ninjas han heredado el Byakugan del Clan, ¿Cómo terminará esta batalla?

programme.title: Naruto: Una Derrota Digna
programme.desc: Hinata se enfrenta a Neji, este ataca usando su Byakugan. El flujo de chakra de Hinata se detiene y casi pierde la consciencia. Hinata recupera su valor al recordar que Naruto no se rinde como ninja.

programme.title: Naruto: Gaara Contra Rock Lee. El Poder De La Juventud Explota
programme.desc: Gaara aparece en el noveno partido y su oponente es Lee. Para enfrentarse a Gaara, Lee utiliza sus poderosos ataques taijutsu. La frenética batalla continúa entre los dos hasta que llega el momento en que la Armadura de Arena de Gaara se suelta…

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Es un hermoso día en la playa y Mr. Bean decide ir a broncearse. ¿Qué podría arruinar este perfecto día? La respuesta es: el clima británico. Se encuentra a si mismo persiguiendo un ilusorio rayo de sol por todo el pueblo.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean se olvida del cumpleaños de su fiel amigo Teddy. La única que se acordó es la novia de Bean, Irma Gobb. Ahora Mr Bean debe decidir cual será el regalo perfecto para Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: El juego de croquet de Mr Wicket es interrumpido por un topo ofensivo. Ella le ordena a Bean sacarlo del jardín.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean es atormentado por los fuertes sonidos de obras viales en su calle, y hace todo lo posible para hacerle frente. Intenta de todas maneras frenar el desagradable sonido pero todo es más complicado de lo que parece.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Al Sr. Bean no le gusta nada más que relajarse en su viejo sofá con una buena comida y su programa de tv favorito. Desafortunadamente, una dolorosa explosión de resortes lo obliga a comprar un sofá nuevo. En el proceso pierde el control remoto.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean va en búsqueda del tesoro después de encontrar un mapa en el ático de la señora Wicket. La cacería comienza llena de pistas engañosas y no será nada fácil.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean busca un nuevo hogar cuando la señora Wicket lo ha echado. Casi llorando, anhela la acogedora familiaridad de su antiguo hogar. Un espantapájaros y un par de dientes postizos vienen a su rescate.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de ver una antigua foto de su niñez, Mr. Bean decide irse de campamento. Sin embargo el viaje desde la tienda hasta el campo se encuentra plagado de dificultades. Nada detendrá a Bean y a Teddy de disfrutar de las estrellas en el cielo nocturno.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de que su modelo de avión fuera derribado por el de su pequeño rival, Mr. Bean construye uno nuevo para competir y tener su venganza. Con Teddy como piloto, la carrera comienza en el espacio aéreo de Londres.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Beans rompe su taza de té favorita, y se dirige a un lugar especial para encontrar otra taza de ese tipo. Allí luchará contra un pequeño canino que se ha robado a Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Hurgando en un viejo baúl en el ático de Mrs Wicket, Mr Bean nos transporta a su juventud. Allí nos develará cuando conoció a su fiel amigo Teddy y cuando aprendió a manejar su mini cooper. Su pasado fue lo que lo convirtió en el hombre que es ahora.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean adopta un misterioso animal rosado perdido. ¿Qué es esta cosa rosa y de dónde vino? Ninguna enciclopedia parece resolver el misterio sobre la identidad de la criatura. Mr Bean deberá insistir hasta encontrar una respuesta.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Irma Gobb tendrá una cena romántica junto a Mr. Bean, pero el no está del todo preparado. Al quedarse dormido en el baño mientras el pollo se cocina en el horno, Mr Bean debe ingeniárselas para tener lista la cena. Un invitado sorpresa tiene la solución.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Una pelota de tenis se atranca en una tubería de drenaje en la azotea. ¿De cuántas maneras diferentes puede Bean intentar recuperarla? Su único problema es el miedo a las alturas.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean muerde un pedazo de palomitas de maíz, lo que le causa mucho dolor. Él piensa que al sacar su diente doloroso, resolverá sus problemas. Quitársela el mismo parece no dar solución y por eso deberá ir al dentista

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean salva a un gatito de un árbol. La prensa y el dueño del gatito llegan a su puerta para tomar una fotografía, pero el cabello de Bean está desordenado, por lo que decide cortarse el pelo."

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Black Kamen Rider

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light, conocido mundialmente como Kira, prueba el alcance de los poderes del Death Note matando a 6 convictos de diferentes maneras, así confirma que puede controlar las acciones de sus víctimas ¡antes de que mueran!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Soichiro Yagami demanda una reunión en persona con L cuando se entera que él secretamente ha traído agentes del FBI a Japón, mientras tanto, Light ha encontrado una manera de sacar a los agentes del FBI ¡permanentemente del caso!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light se reúne con una mujer en el departamento de policía ya que tiene un mensaje importante para el cuerpo especial Kira, como hijo del investigador en jefe, Light escucha su historia y descubre que ella posee información que podría llevar a su arresto!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light usa el Death Note para tratar de deshacerse de la mujer que podría capturarlo, y se sorprende cuando no funciona. Ella le ha dado un nombre falso. Light solo tiene minutos para averiguar su nombre antes de contar su historia a la policía.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: L insiste en plantar micrófonos y cámaras en los hogares de los miembros del cuerpo especial incluyendo la casa de Yagami, pero como siempre, Light está un paso adelante, sabe que está siendo observado!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Los asesinatos continúan y L empieza a sospechar del comportamiento perfecto de Light así que decide investigarlo por su cuenta, para poder alcanzar su meta, L se inscribe a la misma universidad que Light.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Las sospechas de L se profundizan, Light lo persuade de invitarlo a la investigación, pero en ese momento una llamada de teléfono les avisa que ¡Soichiro Yagami ha sufrido un ataque al corazón!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como se predijo en las cintas enviadas a Sakura TV, presentadores de noticias y comentaristas que expresaron dudas sobre Kira mueren uno por uno. Siguiendo las muertes, L concluye que existe un segundo Kira.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Es tiempo extra y Hyuga está preparado para luchar. Ahora enfrenta a Pierre, pero su pierna gravemente herida le impide mantener el control del balón. Francia continúa lanzando una feroz ola de ataques. Mientras tanto, Wakashimazu se retuerce de dolor.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Los tiempos extra y los saques de salida causan presión. El silbato suena. ¿Quién tendrá suerte hoy?

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Finalmente, la gran final. Japón se enfrentará a Alemania. Aunque el equipo japonés ha llegado lejos, hay varios jugadores lesionados. La gran sorpresa es la alineación inicial y el debut de Wakabayashi es ahora. ¡Japón emerge como el país más fuerte!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: ¡Ha llegado el momento del inicio de la final! La investigación de Wakabayashi sobre el equipo Aleman ha demostrado ser exitosa, ya que Japón está dominando el juego. Sólo que esta vez el portero de Alemania es el elusivo Gigante de Acero, Deuter Müller.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Japón está asombrado por la habilidad de Müller para bloquear todos los tiros. De repente, Muller realiza un pase largo hacia Schneider, frente a la portería japonesa. ¡La batalla entre Wakabayashi y Schneider inicia!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: En la primera mitad, la investigación de Wakabayashi favorece a Japón. Japón obtiene otra oportunidad con un tiro libre para el primer punto, pero Müller extrañamente no quiere obstáculos entre él y Tsubasa en la portería.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: El Tiro de Fuego de Schneider puede haber acabado con las esperanzas de Japón de conseguir el primer punto, pero Hyuga está planeando una remontada. Con la ayuda de Tsubasa, se desencadena algo inesperado: ¡la patada más feroz en la historia del fútbol!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Veinticinco minutos en la primera mitad, Tsubasa y Misaki combinan fuerzas para igualar el juego. Ahora, Schneider está aún más motivado y se enfrenta directamente a Wakabayashi. Schneider audazmente desata su Tiro de Fuego. Las chispas vuelan.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Algo ha estado preocupando a Tsubasa. El enigmático mensaje de Katagiri en el entretiempo sobre la página 52 debe hacer referencia al cuaderno, aquel en el que Roberto plasmó todo lo que sabía. Tsubasa revive recuerdos y las lecciones del pasado.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: ¡Japón anota un segundo punto y Alemania está frenética! Schneider no siente su pierna izquierda. Justo cuando parece que la ofensiva Alemana ha cedido bajo presión, Schneider reanima a sus compañeros. El "Obrero de Alemania", Kaltz, está emocionado.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: Un nuevo enemigo

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: Contacto
programme.desc: Sora confronta a Furido, el misterioso personaje que ha abierto las tumbas escondidas.

programme.title: Heidi: La promesa
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier es alérgica a los gatos, pide a Sebastian que los ahogue y encierra a Heidi en el sotano como castigo. Clara ayuda a que Heidi escape para salvar a los gatitos.

programme.title: Heidi: El regreso de papá
programme.desc: Es impresionante el avance que a tenido Clara desde que llegó Heidi, Clara teme que su padre quiera expulsar a Heidi, asi que decide mostrarle ella misma que puede ir sola a la ciudad a comprar su pastel favorito.

programme.title: Heidi: Estudiando en casa
programme.desc: El maestro de Clara regresa de sus vacaciones, para su sorpresa Heidi aún no sabe leer ni escribir por lo que tendrán que separar a las dos amigas ya que su nivel escolar es diferente.

programme.title: Heidi: Preparando un espectáculo
programme.desc: La abuela de Clara llega a cambiar el ambiente de la casa, se da cuenta que el maestro es muy académico. Gracias a la obra que la abuela le enseña a Heidi ella aprender a leer, la abuela se encargará de la educación de las chicas.

programme.title: Heidi: En el parque
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara salen al parque, las chicas conocen a Rudy. Heidi y Rudy van corriendo jugando y Clara trata de alcanzarlos, lamentablemente Clara cae de su silla de ruedas, queda lastimada y Heidi está preocupada ya que a lo mejor Clara y no podrá caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara se pone de pie
programme.desc: Despúes de su accidente Clara no quiere salir de su habitación. La abuela y Heidi intentan animarla pero no lo logran, en secreto Clara esta practicando para poder volver a caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Cabras en la ciudad
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara dan una vuelta de nuevo por el parque, descubren que el parque hay cabras, pero la más bebé esta enferma. Heidi se la lleva a casa para curarla pero debe apresurarse antes de que regrese la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La renuncia
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier regresa y se da cuenta que Heidi tiene a una cabra bebé. Heidi decide irse a vivir con Rudy y tomar un tren para regresar a las montañas. Rottemeier le da una segunda oportunidad a Heidi.

programme.title: Heidi: Un árbol como refugio
programme.desc: Clara ya puede ponerse de pie sin ayuda de nadie. El señor Sesemann quiere adoptar a Heidi, Heidi se aterra de la situación pensando que ya nunca vovler a las montañas. El señor Sesseman entiende el miedo de Heidi y decide posponer la adopción.

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma
programme.desc: Heidi no puede dormir, extraña su vida en las montañas. Todos en la casa piensan que se trata de un fantasma pero en realidad es Heidi que extraña su vida anterior. Clara invita al abuelo a pasar unos días en Frankfurt.

programme.desc: Mire a La Osita Bonnie escuchar sonidos de una clase de música; un artista crea un zoológico de plastilina; y mucho más.

programme.title: Inspiración de color - Arte y música
programme.desc: Vaya en un placentero viaje mientras un artista crea dibujos en arena; títeres de sombras cuentan la historia de un gato rescatado; y otras aventuras.

programme.title: Vocabulario y Números con Harry el Conejo
programme.desc: Hoy, Harry explora todo tipo de cosas dentro y fuera de casa. Su hijo se familiarizará con el color azul, la zanahoria y mucho más.

programme.title: Inspiración de color - Arte y música
programme.desc: Este divertido bloque incluye una representación artística de las frutas saludables como una zanahoria y una manzana; sonidos de la calle con La Osita Bonnie; y más.

programme.title: Inspiración de color - Arte y música
programme.desc: Este bloque incluye el cuadro de una vela brillante; una escena en la playa hecha de plastilina; y mucho más.

programme.title: Inspiración de color - Arte y música
programme.desc: Hoy La Osita Bonnie emprende un viaje a la granja; un picnic de plastilina cobra vida; y un hermoso cuadro de un padre y su hijo es pintado.

programme.title: Clase de bebé: Vocabulario y números
programme.desc: Clase de Bebé ayuda a introducir a sus bebés y niños pequeños a palabras y a bases preescolares. Hoy conocerán nuevos vehículos y se unirán a Fred y Fiona, Harry y Larry, Al y más.

programme.title: Corralito de bebé: Color, movimiento y juego
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy está lleno de descubrimientos, incluyendo un rompecabezas de una manzana y una creación de balón de un loro.

programme.title: Corralito de bebé: Color, movimiento y juego
programme.desc: Observe con su hijo y ayuda a señalar las jirafas en caja sorpresa y el caballo en Peekaboo.

programme.title: Naruto: Jiraiya: El Desastre Potencial De Naruto
programme.desc: Jiraiya y Naruto parten para encontrar a Tsunade, una de los legendarios Sannin. Jiraiya tiene dos propósitos: proteger a Naruto de las garras de la misteriosa organización Akatsuki y entrenar a su aprendiz.

programme.title: Naruto: El Rugir Del Chidori: Los Hermanos Se Enfrentan
programme.desc: Decidido a enfrentarse a Itachi, Sasuke se dirige rápidamente al lugar donde se aloja Naruto. De camino, los recuerdos trágicos de su pasado inundan su mente.

programme.title: Naruto: Odio Entre Los Uchiha: El Último Del Clan
programme.desc: Jiraiya rescata a Naruto de Kisame justo a tiempo. No hay duda de que Itachi y la organización Akatsuki van tras Naruto para obtener el poder del Zorro de las Nueve Colas.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Un Nuevo Entrenamiento Comienza! ¡Voy A Ser Fuerte!
programme.desc: Con profundas heridas físicas y mentales, Sasuke es transportado a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas por Guy. Ojalá la especialista médica, Tsunade, estuviera allí…

programme.title: Naruto: Sigue Entrenando… Hay Que Reventar El Globo De Agua
programme.desc: Naruto por fin comienza su entrenamiento con Jiraiya. La técnica que Naruto aprenderá es la principal del Cuarto Hokage, una técnica que incluso un genio como él tardó tres años en dominar.

programme.title: Naruto: El punto de enfoque, la marca de la Hoja
programme.desc: Naruto consigue completar el primer paso de su entrenamiento. Pero el siguiente paso, hacer que una bola de goma explote con chakra, resulta extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: Naruto: Una elección imposible: El dolor del corazón de Tsunade
programme.desc: Orochimaru y Kabuto aparecen de repente ante Tsunade y Shizune, que están haciendo turismo. Orochimaru, herido por el Sello de la Parca de la Muerte del Tercer Hokage, le pide a la antigua Sannin que utilice sus conocimientos médicos para ayudarlo.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Imperdonable! ¡Una total falta de respeto!
programme.desc: A cambio de haberle curado los brazos, Orochimaru ofrece a Tsunade devolver la vida a su hermano menor Nawaki y a Dan, su amado.

programme.title: Naruto: La herencia, el collar de la muerte
programme.desc: Naruto se enfurece al ver que Tsunade no respeta su posición de Hokage y la reta a un combate.

programme.title: Naruto: “Una Oferta Sospechosa: La Elección De Tsunade”
programme.desc: Naruto practica con todas sus fuerzas para obtener el collar de Tsunade. Mientras tanto, Tsunade no sabe qué responder a la oferta de Orochimaru.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Los Rockmore compran un televisor ultra moderno. Mientras tanto, Chris hace una rifa en Rigby's para sortear un televisor, pero Kel, accidentalmente, se sube encima y lo destroza.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una gran convención de comics en la ciudad y Kenan y Kel no pueden esperar a que llegue el día. Lástima que Kenan tenga que entrenar a la nueva empleada de Rigby's, Sharla, ese mismo día. Los chicos deciden ir de todos modos.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una nueva chica en la clase, Becky. Kel se enamora de ella inmediatamente, cuando descubre que también le gusta la gaseosa de naranja. Pero Kenan está convencido de que su nueva compañera de la escuela es una bruja.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Una estación de radio local está organizando un sorteo y el gran premio son dos entradas para ir a ver al equipo favorito de baloncesto de Kenan y Kel. Para ganar, los muchachos tienen que hacer la pirueta más alocada de todas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es la fiesta de aniversario de los padres de Kenan, y Roger está preparando una sorpresa para Sheryl. Lo único que Kenan tiene que hacer es encargarse de ir a buscar el brazalete y el pastel que su padre compró.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel hacen una prueba de coeficiente intelectual para medir su inteligencia, y Kel, sorpresivamente, obtiene mejores calificaciones que su amigo, así que Kenan sospecha que hubo algún error en los resultados.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una rata suelta en Rigby's que está espantando a todos los clientes. Mientras que Chris quiere llamar a un exterminador para deshacerse de ella, Kel insiste en liberarla y se mete en problemas para salvarle la vida.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Roger y Sheryl llevan Kyra a cenar, mientras que Kenan y Kel se quedan en la habitación de Kenan jugando a un juego de mesa. Cuando terminan de jugar, descubren que unos ladrones se robaron todo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Mientras cena en un restaurante temático de piratas con la familia de Kenan, Kel accidentalmente cambia la flecha de señalización del baño y termina atrapado en el congelador en lugar del baño.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba tiene todos los monstruos necesarios para convocar a Obelisk the Tormentor para acabar con Yugi! Aunque abrumado y superado, ¡nada impedirá que Yugi intente convocar a su Dios egipcio primero!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Cuando Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi choca contra el Obelisco el Atormentador de Kaiba, ¿qué sucederá cuando dos dioses egipcios luchen entre sí? ¡Es hora de descubrir qué Dios egipcio es realmente más fuerte!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El choque de los dos Dioses Monstruos egipcios libera energías místicas que muestran visiones de Yugi y Kaiba del pasado egipcio antiguo! ¿Qué nuevas respuestas desbloquean estas imágenes y qué profecías hacen para el futuro?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba invoca a tres poderosos dragones blancos de ojos azules, pero Yugi no tiene monstruos restantes en su mazo! ¿Perder es solo cuestión de tiempo, o una carta latente de un amigo caído ayudará a cambiar el rumbo de la batalla?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: iCarly: Yo lo ví primero

programme.title: iCarly: El primer beso

programme.title: iCarly: Regalo un auto

programme.title: iCarly: Fred está muerto

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light le da Kiyomi la orden de acabar con Near, justo cuando él piensa que todo va de acuerdo a lo planeado Kiyomi es secuestrada.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Según el acuerdo, Near se encuentra con el SPK en un almacén y, para sorpresa de todos, Near revela que el seguidor de Kira, Mikami, está en el almacén y escribe el nombre de todos en el Death Note.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que Mikami había escrito el nombre de todos los investigadores en el Death Note, ya había pasado un minuto y todos seguían vivos. Near obtiene el Death Note y todo es revelado.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: El brillante pero aburrido estudiante Light Yagami de repente se encuentra sosteniendo el poder de la vida y la muerte en sus manos, el Death Note. Cuando asesinatos empiezan a acumular, el detective L toma el caso y ¡una batalla de inteligencia comienza!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Mientras los criminales del mundo continúan muriendo, L se reúne con representantes de varias naciones. Él solicita que un nuevo cuartel general de la fuerza especial sea creado en Japón bajo la dirección de no otro que Soichiro Yagami ¡El padre de Light!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Ryuk el Shinigami, que dejó caer el Death Note en el mundo humano advierte a Light que alguien le sigue la pista. Light está preocupado por no poder descubrir la identidad de su perseguidor, pero Ryuk le propone un trato sorprendente...

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light, conocido mundialmente como Kira, prueba el alcance de los poderes del Death Note matando a 6 convictos de diferentes maneras, así confirma que puede controlar las acciones de sus víctimas ¡antes de que mueran!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Soichiro Yagami demanda una reunión en persona con L cuando se entera que él secretamente ha traído agentes del FBI a Japón, mientras tanto, Light ha encontrado una manera de sacar a los agentes del FBI ¡permanentemente del caso!

programme.title: Death Note
